values.content:
=Generate a 5-slide Instagram carousel for {{ $json.studio_name }}, a {{ $json.studio_type }} studio.

Brand voice: {{ $json.brand_voice || 'Professional and motivational' }}
Instructor: {{ $json.instructor_name }}{{ $json.instructor_bio ? ' — ' + $json.instructor_bio : '' }}{{ $json.instructor_specialties ? '. Specialties: ' + $json.instructor_specialties : '' }}
{{ $json.topic ? 'Topic: ' + $json.topic : '' }}

Return a JSON array of exactly 5 objects:
[{ "slide_number": 1, "headline": "(max 6 words, punchy hook)", "body": "(max 20 words, value/tip)", "cta": null },
{ "slide_number": 2, "headline": "(max 6 words)", "body": "(max 20 words)", "cta": null },
{ "slide_number": 3, "headline": "(max 6 words)", "body": "(max 20 words)", "cta": null },
{ "slide_number": 4, "headline": "(max 6 words)", "body": "(max 20 words)", "cta": null },
{ "slide_number": 5, "headline": "(closing statement, max 6 words)", "body": "(max 20 words)", "cta": "(one clear call to action, max 8 words)" }]

Make slides flow as a series — each one should make the viewer swipe to the next.
Good carousel topics: 5 reasons to try [class type], Common mistakes in [discipline], What to expect your first class, 5 benefits of [practice], Your week at [studio name].

options.system: You generate Instagram carousel content for fitness studios. Return ONLY valid JSON array, no markdown, no preamble, no explanation. Just the raw JSON array.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: false, error: $json.execution?.error?.message || 'Carousel generation failed' }) }}
